Here is a concise personal summary for the form:

I am curious and I follow through. When I do not understand something, I read about it, then build it to check I have understood. I built InboxDefender to learn how phishing detection works, and I took on the Co-op risk assessments to see how controls fail in practice. I would rather show you something I made than tell you what I know. My MSc in Information Security and my work with access controls, email triage and operational risk assessments are where this focus meets the Technology Risk team’s work.
